title: Network Profiler reports incorrect sync counts when MultiplayerSynchronizer property is set to "On Change"
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
- v4.8.dev2.official [7220d456d]
- v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]
- v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]
- v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]
- v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]

(These are the only versions I checked)

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev2 - Linux Mint 21.3 (Virginia) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (RADV NAVI22) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-4690K CPU @ 3.50GHz (4 threads) - 15.49 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In the sample project I created, the multiplayer authority is set to only update the property (in this case, a Label's text) every 3 seconds. However, in the server's network profiler tab, the Count column reports that the synchronizer is sending updates every frame. In the client's network profiler tab, the Count column remains at "0 - 0"; it doesn't show any updates received at all.

The project works just fine; the text is kept consistent across server and client, and data is not being sent every frame (the bandwidth measures only fluctuate every 3 seconds as expected). But the reporting is wildly incorrect on both sides. This makes troubleshooting network performance difficult.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the sample project.
2. Customize run instances so two windows open; one with --server as a launch argument, and another with no arguments.
3. Run the network profiler for the server window; observe that it reports synchronizer updates are sent very rapidly despite the bandwidth fluctuating every 3 seconds.
4. Run the network profiler for the client window; observe that it reports no synchronizer updates received despite the bandwidth fluctuating every 3 seconds.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[network-profiler-example.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30389893/network-profiler-example.zip)
